newsitem.title: CANADA: I.D. Internet Direct in share placement.
newsitem.headline: I.D. Internet Direct in share placement.

text.p: I.D. Internet Direct Ltd. on Thursday announced a deal with three private investors to make a private placement of 625,000 units at a per share price of C$0.48 to raise C$300,000, subject to regulatory approval.

Each unit will consist of one common share and a two-year warrant entitling the holder to acquire one common share at a price per share of $0.48 during the first year and $0.55 during the second year, the company statement said.
The net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
